acquisition_method.evidence: The spectrometer was operated in data-dependent MS/MS mode with survey scans (top 12) acquired at a resolution of 70,000 at m/z 200 in MS mode in the scanning range of 380–1500 m/z, and 17,500 at m/z 200 in MS2 mode.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Then, samples were digested in trypsin solution (enzyme to protein ratio 1:100, w/w at 37 °C for 18 h)

collision_energy.evidence: Higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) ion fragmentation was performed with normalized collision energies set to 28.

fractionation_method.evidence: peptides were fractionated into two fractions using the SAX (Strong Anion Exchange) technique

fragmentation_method.evidence: Higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) ion fragmentation was performed with normalized collision energies set to 28.

instrument.evidence: Individual fractions were analyzed with the use of Dionex UltiMate 3000 RSLC nanoLC System connected to Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Abundances of identified proteins were estimated using Proteome Discoverer using the Precursor Ions Area detector (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) node with further normalization to the total ion current chromatogram.
